54: There, it is an animal - and it belongs to him, and there is nothing preventing him from sanctifying it. Therefore his utterance has the power to spread [the sanctification across both halves of the animal]. But here, there is another mind as significant as his which can prevent the thing -- since if the woman does not want it, [the money] does not work to betroth her. Only half of her was persuaded, so his words do not effect her [betrothal].
